snippet.title: Assetto Corsa Evoluzione - Pre-Alpha Release
snippet.description:
I am proud to announce the first playable version of my mod for Assetto Corsa. 

I'm using Unity to be able to have menus structured to look like a real game. This will have classic functions as Gran Turismo games like: Car Dealer, Events, Garage and Car Services and many more! It will also support mods.
The ambition is to be able to give Assetto Corsa a breath of fresh air and changes or to makes it looks like a new game.

This will be downloadable from my patreon site. Remember that you can access the official discord for any problem. Enjoy! (Read the README!)

(This is a reupload. Someone asked me if i could remove his part of video.
The meaning of the video is meant to be the same, no content has been changed.)

Patreon: https://patreon.com/alexmail
Discord: https://discord.gg/5tVJgSvDt4
